name: Browse dashboard sections and demo metrics
description: Verifies visitors can open the demo dashboard and navigate to its main operational sections without signing in.
steps: Select Customers, Requests, Transactions, Products, PIN Inventory, and Audit Log from the sidebar
expected: Each section opens without a login prompt and Overview displays clearly labeled synthetic demo metrics.

name: Review and approve a sample service request
description: Verifies a visitor can use dashboard actions to approve a sample request and see the updated status in the demo session.
steps: Select a pending sample request and choose Approve
Verify the request status changes to Approved
expected: The request status updates visibly and a confirmation toast explains that this is a demo-only action.

name: Add a sample product and validate required fields
description: Verifies the product form blocks empty submissions and accepts a valid sample product.
steps: Open Products and choose Add product
Submit the form without a name and verify validation
Enter a product name and price, then save
expected: Empty submission is blocked; a valid product appears in the catalog with a demo-only notice.

name: Export sample transactions on mobile
description: Verifies the transaction section and export control remain usable at mobile width.
steps: Open the demo at mobile width
expected: Transaction rows remain accessible and a CSV file containing synthetic demo transactions is generated.

name: Explore the customer user dashboard
description: Verifies visitors can switch to the customer-facing dashboard, inspect their sample requests and available services, and try the simulated service request action.
steps: Open User Dashboard from the sidebar
Review the sample request list, service prices, and profile
expected: The customer dashboard shows fictional account information and the button explains that ordering and payment are disabled without creating a real request or charge.
